depth_scope.en: Compare shock–density-wave interaction against separately executed Athena++ reference data rather than a finer grid of the same Python code. The additional Noh edition uses volume-centroid conservative MUSCL/minmod with Heun only in spherical runs; planar/cylindrical states stay piecewise constant. The additional low-Mach vortex uses the same unlimited central primitive reconstruction for both Roe variants. It does not verify general limited MUSCL or a TVD guarantee. The additional double rarefaction connects one-dimensional conservative MUSCL, shared Lax–Friedrichs fluxes, mean-preserving positive-state scaling and SSPRK(3,3). Check the admissible CFL/wave-speed conditions, means and faces at each forward-Euler candidate/SSP stage, and conservation budgets; this does not certify general Euler, WENO, DG or MHD positivity.

title.ja: Noh衝撃波：初期圧力ゼロの平面・円筒・球対称計算
title.en: Noh shocks: zero-pressure planar, cylindrical and spherical flow

summary.ja: 初期圧力ゼロのNoh問題を、独自の小型1D有限体積コードで平面・円筒・球対称に計算します。64/128/256/512格子の全域誤差、原点過熱、衝撃位置、保存収支を測り、球で現れる境界流入の時間積分誤差を解析式と照合します。
summary.en: An original small 1D finite-volume code solves zero-pressure Noh flow in planar, cylindrical and spherical symmetry. Grids 64/128/256/512 measure full-domain error, origin heating, shock location and budgets, and compare spherical boundary-inflow time-quadrature error with its analytic identity.

assumptions.ja: 無次元r∈[0,1]、γ=5/3、ρ0=1、u0=-1、p0=0、T=.6。平面d=1・円筒半径対称d=2・球半径対称d=3をPDE実行し、衝撃半径は.2。外側密度は(1+t)^(d-1)、原点は反射、体積測度r^(d-1)dr。角度因子をすべての収支から共通に省き、球の解析総量はM=512/375、E=256/375です。球の図は1D半径解の中心断面で、Cartesianの2D/3D計算や角度方向の対称性破れの検証ではありません。
assumptions.en: Nondimensional r in [0,1], gamma=5/3, rho0=1, u0=-1, p0=0, T=.6. PDE runs use planar d=1, cylindrical-radial d=2 and spherical-radial d=3, with shock radius .2. Outer density is (1+t)^(d-1), the origin reflects, and the measure is r^(d-1)dr. The same angular factor is omitted throughout; spherical analytic totals are M=512/375 and E=256/375. Its figure is a central section of a 1D radial solution, not a Cartesian 2D/3D calculation or a test of angular symmetry breaking.

algorithm.ja: Rusanov流束とSSPRK2（Heun）を使用します。平面・円筒は従来の区分定数再構築、球は保存量を体積重心の周りにMUSCL型線形再構築し、内部セルは重心間距離によるminmod傾きを使い、両端の境界セルは傾き0とします。各セル共通の係数θで左右面の全保存量傾きを縮小し、密度と内部エネルギーの面状態を検査します。セル平均の修正・圧力seed・floorは使いません。波速、Rusanov流束、数値応力P*=F_mom−((u_L+u_R)/2)F_massは同じ面状態から計算し、幾何CFLはV/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R)、指定値.35です。球では線形面応力の∫2rP*(r)drを厳密積分、平面・円筒は旧算術平均求積を保持します。反射面は再構築後の面状態を偶奇反転し、外側の冷たい流入は物理流束で与えます。各RK段の有限性・密度・内部エネルギーを検査し、不正なら失敗を記録します。
algorithm.en: Rusanov flux with SSPRK2 (Heun). Planar/cylindrical runs retain piecewise-constant reconstruction. Spherical runs reconstruct conserved variables linearly around volume centroids with minmod slopes based on centroid distances in interior cells and zero slopes in the two boundary cells. A single theta per cell scales all conserved slopes at both faces to check face density/internal energy. Cell means are never corrected and no pressure seed/floor is used. Wave speeds, Rusanov flux and numerical stress P*=F_mom-((u_L+u_R)/2)F_mass use the same face states. The geometric CFL V/(A_La_L+A_Ra_R) uses the prescribed .35. Spherical source quadrature exactly integrates the face-linear numerical stress against 2r dr; planar/cylindrical runs keep the old arithmetic rule. Reconstructed reflection faces use even/odd parity, with physical cold inflow at the outer face. Every RK stage is checked and invalid states cause a retained failure.

validation.ja: 旧平面・円筒の受入基準と59判定を保持し、球の追加基準・入力・ソースhashを初回の球PDE実行前に保存します。初回の円筒不合格はソース・全8本の診断ログ・不合格サマリーを保持し、同じ基準で面応力版を再検証した履歴です。厳密保存量セル平均は衝撃をまたぐ積分を分割し、p(平均U)と平均pを分けます。固定版LANL ExactPackの独立解析照合はd=1/2/3を含みます。球の新規PDE系列では全域r²重みL1/L2/L∞、原点を含むr≤.70rsの密度L1、原点・衝撃・plateauを別測定。各段の境界流入による離散保存収支と、連続解析総量との差を分け、M_h−M_exact=Σdt³/6、E_h−E_exact=Σdt³/12というSSPRK2境界求積の恒等式を検査します。 最初の球対称実行は旧算術平均源のまま105条件中2条件で不合格（最細衝撃位置3.923セル、plateau密度誤差11.03%）となり、全結果を保存しました。第2試行は球の面応力求積だけを変更しましたが、同じ2条件が未達（衝撃位置3.919セル、密度誤差11.018%）でした。第3試行はその求積を保ち、球だけMUSCL・minmod再構築を加えて、同じ105条件で比較します。 第3試行は28検査と全12格子計算を完了し、105条件すべてに合格しました。球N=512では全域密度L1=.0114343、衝撃位置誤差1.98856セル、plateau密度誤差5.2533%、原点込みcore密度L1=.0549503です。一方、中心最大比内部エネルギーの相対過剰は20.59%で、第2試行の15.52%より悪化しており、全指標の改善は主張しません。
validation.en: Retain the planar/cylindrical acceptance file and all 59 original decisions, and save spherical criteria, inputs and source hashes before the first spherical PDE run. The initial cylindrical failure retains its source, all eight diagnostic logs and failed summary; the face-stress revision was tested against the same gates. Analytic conserved means split shock-crossing integrals and distinguish p(mean U) from mean p. The pinned independent LANL ExactPack analytic comparison includes d=1/2/3. New spherical PDE refinements separately measure full-domain r^2-weighted L1/L2/Linf, density L1 in r<=.70rs including the origin, and center/shock/plateau diagnostics. Discrete stage-weighted inflow budgets are distinct from continuous analytic totals; SSPRK2 boundary quadrature is checked through M_h-M_exact=sum(dt^3)/6 and E_h-E_exact=sum(dt^3)/12. The first spherical run retained arithmetic source quadrature and failed two of 105 gates (finest shock-position error 3.923 cells, plateau-density error 11.03%); all results are retained. A second attempt changed only spherical stress quadrature, but still failed the same two gates (3.919 cells and 11.018% density error). A third attempt retains that quadrature and adds MUSCL/minmod reconstruction only for spherical runs, against the same 105 criteria. The third attempt completed 28 tests and all 12 grid runs, passing all 105 gates. At spherical N=512 the whole-domain density L1 is .0114343, shock error 1.98856 cells, plateau-density error 5.2533%, and origin-inclusive core-density L1 .0549503. Maximum center specific-internal-energy excess is 20.59%, worse than the second attempt's 15.52%; not every diagnostic improves.

limits.ja: 平面・円筒は空間一次、球はMUSCL型の制限線形再構築を使う教育用計算です。原点過熱と有限格子のplateau誤差が残り、全域誤差から原点を除外しません。r²重みで中心欠陥が小さく見えるため、原点を含む固定coreの誤差と拡大図も示します。L∞や中心最大誤差のゼロ収束、滑らかな球問題での方式全体の高次精度、幾何源付き全RK段階の一般の正値性保証、Cartesian多次元、任意γの独立照合は検証していません。円筒L∞は旧系列で単調減少せず、球のL2/L∞と過熱も診断値として保持します。球の離散質量・エネルギー収支が丸め誤差でも、解析総量との差は境界時間求積のO(dt²)となります。半径方向の運動量には幾何源があり、保存されるCartesian運動量とは異なります。ExactPackは解析評価器の独立実装で、別の数値PDEエンジンではありません。
limits.en: An educational calculation: first-order space in planar/cylindrical flow and MUSCL-type limited linear reconstruction in spherical flow. Origin heating and finite-grid plateau errors remain; the center is never removed from whole-domain error. Because r^2 weighting can make central defects appear small, an origin-inclusive fixed-core norm and enlarged view are also shown. Vanishing Linf/center maximum error, high order for the complete method on smooth spherical problems, general stage positivity with the geometric source, Cartesian multidimensional flow and independent arbitrary-gamma validation are not established. Cylindrical Linf was not monotone in the old series; spherical L2/Linf and heating are retained as diagnostics. Roundoff-scale discrete mass/energy balance coexists with O(dt^2) spherical boundary-time-quadrature error against analytic totals. Radial momentum has a geometric source and is not a conserved Cartesian momentum component. ExactPack independently implements the analytic evaluator, not another numerical PDE engine.

title.ja: 低Mach等エントロピー渦：前処理Roe流束の軽量検証
title.en: Low-Mach isentropic vortex: preconditioned Roe flux verification

summary.ja: 同じ非線形2次元Euler渦をN=16/32/64、背景Mach数.1/.01でT=.1まで進め、通常RoeとMiczek型の空間流束前処理を比較します。全12計算で、速度・動圧スケールの圧力誤差、保存収支、音響刻み、実段状態を調べます。
summary.en: The same nonlinear 2D Euler vortex is evolved to T=0.1 on N=16/32/64 at background Mach 0.1/0.01, comparing ordinary Roe with Miczek spatial flux preconditioning. Twelve fixed runs retain velocity and dynamically scaled pressure errors, conserved budgets, acoustic steps and actual stage states.

assumptions.ja: 領域[-10,10]²、周期境界、γ=1.4、β=3、背景ρ∞=1とU∞=(1,.5)。p∞=|U∞|²/(γM∞²)とし、流速と渦強度を固定して背景Mach数を変えます。M∞は局所最大Mach数ではありません。全平面の移動等エントロピー渦を最小像座標で評価し、有限周期箱のGaussian裾の継ぎ目を別に評価します。保存量のセル平均は8点Gauss求積で初期化・比較し、16点と照合します。閉形式の厳密セル平均や一般の厳密周期渦とは呼びません。
assumptions.en: Periodic [-10,10]^2, gamma=1.4, beta=3, background density 1 and velocity (1,0.5). Set p_infinity=|U_infinity|^2/(gamma M_infinity^2), retaining the same flow and vortex strengths. Background Mach is not maximum local Mach. A whole-plane translating isentropic vortex is evaluated with minimum-image coordinates and a separately qualified Gaussian seam. Conserved cell means use eight-point tensor Gauss quadrature, checked against order 16; they are not closed-form exact means or a generic exactly periodic nonlinear vortex.

algorithm.ja: 同じ無制限の中心原始変数MUSCL再構築・有限体積・物理Euler流束・SSPRK(3,3)を使い、Roe散逸だけをD=P⁻¹|PA|で前処理します。Roe平均の全流速Machからμ=min(1,max(Mlocal,M∞))、δ=1/μ−1とし、原始変数のMiczek行列を保存量へ変換します。行列絶対値は特性値ũn,ũn±τの2次多項式で作用させ、別の密行列固有分解と照合します。物理時間微分・音速は変えず、音響CFL=.2を使います。再構築した両面と各3段の正のρ,pを確認し、limiter・floor・状態修復・隠れた再試行・疑似時間反復はありません。前進Eulerの増幅反例を示すため、SSP・TVD・非線形安定性を名前だけで保証しません。
algorithm.en: Both finite-volume variants use the same unlimited centered primitive-MUSCL reconstruction,  the physical Euler flux and SSPRK(3,3); only Roe dissipation is replaced by D=P^-1|PA|. At each Roe state use the total-speed Mach with mu=min(1,max(M_local,M_infinity)) and delta=1/mu-1, applying the primitive Miczek matrix through conserved-variable Jacobians. A degree-two characteristic polynomial applies the matrix absolute value; a separate dense eigendecomposition checks it. Physical time and sound speed are unchanged; acoustic CFL=0.2 remains. Reconstructed faces and all three stages check positive density and pressure, without limiters, floors, repair, hidden retries or pseudo-time iteration. A forward-Euler amplification counterexample prevents claiming SSP/TVD or general nonlinear stability from the integrator name.

validation.ja: 初版の32単体検査は合格しましたが、区分定数空間離散化での143判定中、M∞=.01・最細格子の全領域圧力誤差.16537が事前閾値.1を超えました。初版ソース・契約・全12場・判定と、その全領域図を失敗のまま保存します。改訂では両流束を同じ無制限中心原始変数MUSCLにし、面状態の拒否・正しい再構築Fourier記号・独立行列を使う実RHSの線形化など3検査を追加しました。入力・物理時間・CFL・受入条件はバイト単位で不変です。新35検査と143条件の契約を改訂の実行前に固定しました。 Roe平均の保存量ジャンプと物理流束差、密行列の前処理散逸、3段更新・不正段保持を照合します。各背景Mach・流束で17²個の定数状態Fourierモードと、物理音響エネルギーで規格化した増幅行列の1/10/100乗を調べます。圧力誤差は大きなp∞ではなくρ∞|U∞|²で割り、速度誤差は渦の速度変動で規格化します。移動解析場に対する初期R_h−q_tも記録し、定常残差の収束とは区別します。 改訂の35検査・全12計算143判定は-W errorで合格し、元のMacで全計算は約4.4秒でした。最細M∞=.01の速度相対L1はRoe .07411、前処理 .01847、固定コアの圧力誤差は.04871/.0006325でした。一方、全領域の圧力誤差は.01194/.01260で前処理側がわずかに悪く、M∞=.1でも.0006653/.0006737と同様です。全4保存量の最大相対残差は4.24e-14。Gauss8/16の動的スケール最大差は4.08e-11、解析Euler代入残差は1.09e-16でした。指定したFourierモードのSSPRK3増幅半径とエネルギー規格化行列累乗ノルムは最大1。前進Eulerは両MUSCL流束で1を超え、M∞=.01の前処理側で約1.03560でした。
validation.en: The original 32 unit tests passed, but one of 143 first-order spatial gates failed: finest M_infinity=0.01 whole-domain dynamic pressure error 0.16537 exceeded the fixed 0.1 threshold. Original sources, contract, all twelve fields and the failed global pressure plot are retained. Revision 2 gives both fluxes the same unlimited centered primitive MUSCL and adds three checks for reconstruction, raw face failure and actual-RHS linearization against independent matrices. Inputs, physical time, CFL and acceptance bytes are unchanged; the revised 35-test/143-gate contract was frozen before revision execution.  Checks cover Roe conserved jumps and physical-flux differences, dense-matrix dissipation, the three stages and raw invalid-stage retention. Each background Mach/flux has 17^2 constant-state Fourier modes and powers 1/10/100 in stated physical acoustic-energy variables. Pressure errors divide by rho_infinity*|U_infinity|^2 rather than the large p_infinity; velocity errors divide by analytic vortex perturbations. Initial R_h-q_t for the translating analytic field is retained as truncation error, not converged steady residual. Revision 2 passed all 35 tests, twelve runs and 143 gates with -W error, taking about 4.4 seconds on the original Mac. At finest M_infinity=0.01, relative velocity L1 was 0.07411 for Roe and 0.01847 for preconditioning; fixed-core pressure errors were 0.04871/0.0006325. Whole-domain pressure errors were instead 0.01194/0.01260, slightly worse with preconditioning; M_infinity=0.1 similarly gave 0.0006653/0.0006737. Maximum relative conserved-budget residual was 4.24e-14. Dynamic-scale Gauss8/16 maximum difference was 4.08e-11 and analytic Euler substitution residual 1.09e-16. Sampled SSPRK3 spectral radii and stated energy-scaled matrix powers had maximum 1. Forward Euler exceeded 1 for both MUSCL variants, reaching about 1.03560 for preconditioning at M_infinity=0.01.

limits.ja: T=.1だけの短時間・少数格子の検証で、渦の一周や長時間保存を確認したものではありません。Fourier検査は指定した一様背景・離散波数・増幅回数の範囲であり、全波数や可変状態の非線形安定性・正値性の証明ではありません。実計算では音響CFLを維持し、対流刻みで進めたとは主張しません。定常解の加速、dual time、衝撃波・接触の頑健性、一般格子やMach数全域は未検証です。解析場の有限周期箱、Gauss求積、セル平均からの原始変数評価を区別し、圧力のMach依存や局所誤差を成功値だけに置き換えません。 無制限MUSCLは滑らかなこの入力の選択であり、limiter・TVD法・一般的な正値性保証ではありません。初版で現れた箱全体の圧力波を角の切り取りだけで隠さず、追加図で全領域の失敗を示します。 速度や固定コアの改善を圧力全域へ一般化できません。最細の全領域圧力L1は前処理側が少し大きく、M∞を10分の1にすると前処理の全域圧力誤差も増えています。圧力精度のMach独立性はこの実測から主張しません。運動エネルギー比は保存セル平均から求めた速度変動の診断で、連続場の運動エネルギーの厳密保存ではありません。
limits.en: This is a short T=0.1 fixed-input, few-grid test, not a full circulation or long-time preservation study. The Fourier check covers selected uniform states, wave numbers and powers; it is no proof for all modes, nonlinear variable states or general positivity. Actual integration retains the acoustic CFL and does not use the displayed convective diagnostic step. Steady convergence acceleration, dual time, shock/contact robustness, general meshes and all Mach numbers remain unverified. Finite periodic-box seams, Gauss quadrature and primitive variables evaluated from cell means remain distinct qualifications. Pressure Mach dependence and local errors are retained. Unlimited MUSCL is selected for these smooth inputs, not a limiter, TVD method or general positivity guarantee. The original box-wide pressure waves are shown in a separate full-domain failed-trial figure rather than hidden by the gallery core crop. Velocity/core improvements do not imply globally better pressure: finest whole-domain pressure L1 is slightly larger with preconditioning and grows when background Mach is reduced by ten. No Mach-independent pressure accuracy follows from these measurements. Perturbation kinetic energy is a diagnostic computed from conserved cell means, not exact conservation of continuous kinetic energy.

summary.en: Evolve the existing strong double rarefaction on 128/256/512 cells, connecting mean-preserving positivity scaling to MUSCL, global LF fluxes and SSPRK(3,3). Log density, pressure and boundary budgets for every FE substep and SSP convex combination.

assumptions.ja: γ1.4、x∈[0,1]、x0=.5、左右状態(ρ,u,p)=(1,−2,.4)/(1,2,.4)、T=.15を固定します。中心の密度・圧力は小さいものの正で、真空生成例ではありません。大域LF分離速度a=4、dt·a/dx≤.4を固定し、実際の全端点の|u|+c≤aと十分条件dt·a/dx≤1/2を確認します。
assumptions.en: Fix gamma1.4, x in [0,1], discontinuity x0=.5, outer primitive states(1,-2,.4)/(1,2,.4) and T=.15. The low-density central state remains strictly positive; this is not a vacuum-generating case. Use fixed global LF splitting speed a4 and dt*a/dx<=.4; assert every actual endpoint satisfies |u|+c<=a and the sufficient dt*a/dx<=1/2 condition.

algorithm.ja: 保存量の無制限中央線形再構築を行い、セル平均と左右2端点へ共通の係数θを用いて密度・圧力を正にします。端点平均は元の保存量平均のままです。共有LF流束による前進Euler更新をSSPRK(3,3)で凸結合し、各段の流束前に再構築と制限をやり直します。ε=10⁻¹³は再構築の目標で、密度・エネルギーを加えるfloorではありません。平均の修復・無言の刻み再試行は行いません。
algorithm.en: Unlimited conservative central linear reconstruction is scaled toward its mean with one common theta per cell until both endpoint densities/pressures are positive. The two endpoint mean remains the original conserved mean. Shared LF FE updates are combined by SSPRK(3,3), reconstructing/limiting before every flux stage. Epsilon1e-13 is a reconstruction target, not an injected density/energy floor. No average repair or hidden time-step retries are used.

validation.ja: 27単体検査と3格子73判定を実行前に固定します。スケーリング前に生じる負の端点圧力を保持し、制限後の端点・前進Euler平均・SSP凸結合平均、θ、全3保存量の境界流束収支を別々に測ります。閉形式の対称希薄波と既存の独立な対数圧力根探索を照合し、保存量のGauss8/16セル平均との誤差と格子細分化を記録します。
validation.en: Freeze 27 unit tests and 73 gates over three grids before execution. Retain negative raw endpoint pressures, then separately measure limited endpoints, FE means, SSP convex means, theta and all three boundary-flux conservation budgets. Cross-check the closed symmetric fan against the prior independent logarithmic-pressure root evaluator; record errors/refinement against conserved Gauss8/16 cell means.

limits.ja: この一つのP1有限体積更新と固定入力の検証です。一般のMUSCL/WENO/DG、特性再構築、反射壁、真空生成、2D/3Dの正値性を認証しません。空間再構築は無制限中央傾きで、TVD・最大値原理・無振動性を保証しません。生の端点圧力は密度が正の端点だけで評価し、密度≤0は別に数えます。圧力参照は保存量セル平均から評価するp(q̄)で、平均圧力とは異なります。ギャラリー図は保存した1次元場のx–t表示であり、2次元流体計算ではありません。ExactPackや別のPDEエンジンを実行した例ではありません。
limits.en: Evidence covers this one P1 FV update and fixed input, not general MUSCL/WENO/DG, characteristic reconstruction, reflecting walls, vacuum generation or multidimensional positivity. Unlimited central slopes have no TVD, maximum-principle or nonoscillation guarantee. Raw pressure is evaluated only where raw density is positive; nonpositive raw density has its own count. Reference pressure is p(mean conserved q), not mean pressure. Gallery plots are saved one-dimensional x-t fields, not two-dimensional flow. No ExactPack or separate PDE engine is executed.
